name: Amitriptyline
status: DRAFT – pharmacology (†) is not yet checked against the package insert; doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text

item_format: t=text, s=source:printed page, d=dagger, b=bold, h=heading

moa.t: Inhibits serotonin and noradrenaline reuptake, antimuscarinic, antihistamine and α-blocking effects

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Amitriptyline, oral, 10–25 mg at night. · Titrate dose according to response. · Initial dose in the elderly: 10 mg at night.
Amitriptyline, oral, 10–25 mg at bedtime. · Up-titrate dose to adequate clinical response. · Doses greater than 75 mg are seldom required.
Amitriptyline, oral, 10 mg at night. · Increase to a maximum of 75 mg at night. · May be used during withdrawal of acute or symptomatic headache
Amitriptyline, oral, at bedtime. · Initial dose: 25 mg per day.
Amitriptyline, oral, at bedtime. · Start with 25 mg, increase by 25 mg/day at 3-to 4-day intervals. · Dose range: 75 to 150 mg daily.
Amitriptyline, oral, 10–25 mg at night increasing to 100 mg, if necessary.
Amitriptyline, oral, 25 mg at night. (Doctor prescribed.) · Titrate as necessary to a maximum of 75 mg.
Amitriptyline, oral, 25 mg at night. · Increase dose to 50 mg after two weeks if needed. · Increase to 75 mg after a further two weeks if needed.
Amitriptyline, oral, 25 mg at night (Doctor prescribed). · Titrate at two weekly intervals to a maximum of 75 mg at night.
Amitriptyline, oral, at bedtime. · Initial dose: 25 mg per day. · Increase by 25 mg per day at 3- to 5-day intervals.
Amitriptyline, oral, 10 mg at night. (Doctor initiated.). · Titrate up to a maximum of 75 mg at night.
Amitriptyline, oral, 0.5–1 mg/kg 8 hourly. · Maximum: 25 mg/dose.
Amitriptyline, oral, 0.1–1 mg/kg 8 hourly. · Start on a low dose and titrate up according to symptoms. · Maximum: 25 mg/dose.

cautions.t: Low doses at night for neuropathic pain

adverse_effects.t: Sedation, dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention, postural hypotension, weight gain, QT prolongation
